status_at_creation: Frozen before fine-tuning or candidate predictions

training.method: Warm-start the parent LoRA adapter and pointer head; freeze the backbone
training.preflight: Two longest training records, one update per record; discard the probe for model selection

selection.fine_tuned_checkpoint: Highest dev macro-F1; then dev accuracy; then fewer epochs
selection.test_policy: Score the selected fine-tune, parent, and frozen class-bias baseline once. Do not revise settings based on test results.
selection.class_bias: Use parent probabilities at temperature 1. Fit high and low log-probability offsets on train with medium fixed at zero. Grid -3 to 3 in 0.25 increments. Select regularization from 0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1 on dev macro-F1, then accuracy, then smaller bias norm. Training objective is macro-F1 minus regularization times squared bias norm.

evaluation.backend: MLX bf16 for every checkpoint, merged adapter, temperature 1
evaluation.input: Original task prompt and unchanged English choice rubric; no labels or metadata in the model input
evaluation.latency: Sequential local inference; warm up on one training record. Save forward timer and end-to-end predictor timer. Exclude initialization and warmup. No HTTP server.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired family bootstrap, seed 42, 5000 resamples; only five test families, so intervals remain exploratory.

constraints: Only one training or model evaluation process at a time
No cloud GPU provisioning or model publication
Keep trained adapters, heads, logs, predictions, and the experiment model cache for local reuse.
All 192 prompts were examined in the previous baseline study. This is not a pristine independent test set.
No claim about general Kev task retention or production routing cost without separate evaluation
data_policy: Reuse the exact frozen 4B train/dev/test bytes and manifest; no new split or rubric changes.
